dispositions.KEEP_IN_SKILL: Already the skill's own knowledge; stays, but must be registry-backed (rule_id/decision_id/provenance/confidence) and every documentation copy must be generated from, or verified against, the registry.
dispositions.MIGRATE_TO_SKILL: Aesthetic knowledge that currently lives in design-compiler. Moves into the skill rule registry with provenance; the compiler-side literal is deleted.
dispositions.DELETE_DUPLICATE: A second copy of a value/definition that already has a canonical home. Deleted (or turned into a generated reference); never reconciled by averaging.
dispositions.DERIVED_RUNTIME_ONLY: A runtime number the compiler still needs. It is no longer authored in the compiler: it arrives through the AestheticConstraintSheet, carries source_ref -> rule_id -> decision_id, and is lint-checked.

out_of_scope_classes.MEASUREMENT_MECHANISM: Operational definition of how a metric is measured from pixels/frames (estimator). Stays in the compiler; the estimator identity and bias are declared in the contract's metric definitions.
out_of_scope_classes.PHYSICAL_SAFETY: Physical/runtime safety envelopes, security and determinism machinery (path sandboxing, crash recovery, matrix math, canonical hashing, capability tiers). Not aesthetic judgement.
out_of_scope_classes.FIDELITY_METRIC: Frozen 5-D fidelity evaluators that compare render to target. Verification mechanism owned by the compiler.
out_of_scope_classes.CAPABILITY_TIER: Host capability tiers and data-quality (G1) policy.
out_of_scope_classes.EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY: Gates that detect fabricated or unreferenced evidence (provenance integrity), not taste.
out_of_scope_classes.DOCS_NON_AESTHETIC: Technical acceptance criteria in playbooks (image resolution, byte sizes, bit depth).
out_of_scope_classes.SELECTION_MECHANISM: Zero-implicit-rule operator selection: an operator is chosen only when a declared principle AND an active relationship both match (set cardinality checks, no aesthetic magnitude).

file_classes.reason: Estimator definitions (e.g. negative space = luma>=180 and 3x3 variance<100). Declared as estimators in the contract; their bias vs the design-level void ratio is documented in ADR-0001.
Relationship derivation algebra over [0,1]-normalised evidence; only constant interpretation parameter (solid-void ratioSpread) is tracked as RL-DC-GRAPH-PARAM.
Schema validation and fingerprinting of the intent extension; no aesthetic numbers.
Unicode safety, RFC 8785 canonical hashing, immutable asset registry, matrix math.
WebGL pipeline, degradation ladder, camera matrices, RAF/power state machines.
Scene-pack emission/validation/crash recovery and asset compilers (path sandbox, hashes, format sniffing).
SceneCompilationIR physical safe intervals (PARAMETER_RANGES) and capability guard; a safety envelope, not taste.
Runtime range guard / unsupported-operation watchdog of the Aesthetic-to-Runtime adapter (physical envelope).
Detects hard-coded / unreferenced / overconfident evidence fields.
Frozen ABI 1.0.0 5-D fidelity evaluators and feedback engine.
G1 data-gate confidence policy (data quality, not taste).
Scoring engine mechanism (weights-sum gate); the weights themselves are RL-DC-WEIGHTS.
Procedure/verification criteria (technical specs); aesthetic thresholds quoted there must reference registry rule ids (docs lint).
Cardinality checks of matching principles/relations; which principles activate which operators is data supplied by the decision pack, not a literal here.
